limitations: Five repetitions on 73 English inputs; three on 12 Japanese inputs. No repeats excluded.
English B3 includes 24 full groups and one singleton tail, all with explicit chunk4. B1 uses chunk1.
Each variant is paired with the previous optimized runtime on the same loaded backend/engines. Separate variants use separate processes.
Eager diagnostic traces are not CUDA graph phase measurements. Decoder call counts are unchanged by fusion.
Peak memory includes resident comparison sessions. Initial JIT/capture timing is order-dependent.
Japanese B1 reference has one group CV17.50%; all12 paired group medians still improve. Raw samples retained.
No reference timestamp accuracy evaluated; timestamp and segment comparisons are against the reference runtime.
Only H200/1B/beam5/B1 and B3 measured. Other GPUs, models and beam widths unverified.
Default/API routing changed after the GPU snapshot; subsequent CPU checks do not constitute a second GPU run.

whole_job_gpu_utilization.scope: 5s sampling across setup, tests, warm-up, all modes; not per-mode utilization
